title: Mixed Event — Raise Your Bow in a Snow-White World

meta.Event: Raise Your Bow in a Snow-White World
meta.Outline: One day at the archery club, by a strange coincidence, Shizuku senses something hidden beneath Mafuyu's smile. It reminds her of the time when they met for the first time and...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Just ten more seconds.
Keep going, everyone! You can do it!

rows.Speaker: First-Year Archery Club Member A
rows.Line:
Hnng...! Fifty-five, fifty-six, fifty-seven...!
Planking's so hard!

rows.Speaker: First-Year Archery Club Member A
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
I thought I was done for!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Everyone, that was very impressive.
You've all grown so much since you first joined this club, and this is proof of that.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I know it's not for a while, but I believe you'll all do wonderfully during our next tournament. So, please keep up the good work.

rows.Speaker: First-Year Archery Club Members A & B
Shizuku
rows.Line: Now that we're finished doing strength drills, let's get the targets ready...

rows.Speaker: First-Year Archery Club Member A
rows.Line:
Oh, we'll put them up!
Please take a break, Hinomori.

rows.Speaker: First-Year Archery Club Member A
rows.Line: This is so great! Hinomori praised us!

rows.Speaker: First-Year Archery Club Member B
rows.Line: And she seemed totally fine while planking just now! I guess idols need to keep their cool like that, huh?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Thank you for running strength drills with the first years today.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I noticed that they were beginning to lose their focus a little after competing in the newcomer tournament, so I appreciate you stopping by today.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I didn't do anything special, really.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I mean, I haven't been able to show up for practice much lately because of MORE MORE JUMP! activities...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Yes, I'll head over now.
Good luck with practicing for the individuals match, Asahina!

rows.Speaker: Archery Club Members
rows.Line: Thank you very much! If you'll excuse us!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: There was no one left in the changing room.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Okay. Then, let's start closing up.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh, it's my turn today, so I'll return the key to the teachers.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Thank you, but I'll go with you...
There's something I need to ask them.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
You will?
Hehe. Then, shall we?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: The first years have become much better archers since I last saw them.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Yes, I believe the newcomer tournament played a big role.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I suppose it's only natural to take official matches more seriously.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (When I was a first year, I received quite a lot of advice from others around this time of year, which helped me have more confidence in myself...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (So much was going on back then...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Look, they're all in the studying room together.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Oh, you're right.
They all seem to be working very hard...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: They've all retired from club activities and have entrance exams coming up. And when I go down the third years' corridor, there's a sort of tension in the air.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: When we become third years, the time will also come for us to retire and study...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Yes, you're right...
I know it's inevitable, but that time will eventually come...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I feel a little sad about that actually.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Me too. Especially since we've been doing this since we were first years.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: However, we have our futures to think about, and that's going to be our time to decide what we want to do in life...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Oh, Asahina, speaking of which...
You're trying to get into medical school, yes?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Hehe. The first years told me.
Some of them saw you buying study guides for it.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
I see.
I feel a little embarrassed now.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
No, don't.
You'd make a wonderful doctor since you're such a kind person.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: So, please do your best, Asahina.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I need to do my best.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Oh, um...
It looked like you were thinking about something else just now.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Hehe. I must've been thinking about entrance exams again and how much I have to study for them.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (But she seemed different compared to normal for some reason...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: That reminds me, Hinomori. When you were a first year, you decided to join the archery club as a way to improve your posture, yes?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Huh? Yes, that's right...
I vaguely remember mentioning that when we first visited the club.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Yes, and it left an impression on me because your posture was already very good. I suppose I should expect no less from an idol.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
No, it's just...
I was still trying to get started as an idol back then.

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line: Oh, what are you two still doing here? It's time to head home for the day.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Oh, hello.
We were just about to return the key to the archery range...

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line: Ah, I was just about to head back. Why don't I deliver that for you?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
You will?
Thank you very much.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Oh, Shii, it's you...
I'm sorry. You startled me a little. Is there something you need...?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: You seemed more than a little startled. Well, anyway... I came to let you know that it's your turn to take a bath.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: But there's something on my mind right now, so I think I'll wait until later to take a bath.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Yes, but I appreciate your concern.
Something is bothering me a little is all.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, but I'm not sure how to put it into words...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: So, I'd like some time to think on it more.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
To get a better idea...
Okay, I understand.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: In that case, I'll let Mom know that she can go before you.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Thank you, Shii!
I really appreciate it!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (It's just like what I saw that other time...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (She seemed to have something on her mind that time as well.)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (Does that mean there's something bothering her...?)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: But I could be jumping to the wrong conclusion...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hm? I thought I heard someone calling my...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
<Good evening!
Sorry, we know it's late!>

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
KAITO? Miku?
It's awfully late for you to be visiting me.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <We came here hoping that we could ask you for some advice, Shizuku.>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Yes! We were thinking about altering some of our costumes for our next show.>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <They're ones that have been sitting in the dressing room and we want to change things up a little.>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Remember how you all came up with your own costume designs? We decided to think up ideas for alterations in the same way...>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
<Yes, me too.
I've also been having trouble coming up with ideas.>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <So, Shizuku, since you're really good at coming up with design ideas, we thought we should ask you.>

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Yes, I see...
I'm not as good as you say I am, but I'll be more than happy to help.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <If possible, we'd like to have something warm that goes with the season...>

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Something warm...
In that case, why not try using a fluffy material that insulates well for the sleeves?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Also, something that looks like ice crystals. Not only will they look pretty, they'll give your costumes a nice, wintery feel.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: You could even have imitation snow fall from above to go along with your costumes.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
I-I'm sorry!
Our conversation reminded me of something else...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
<Something else?
Oh, is there something bothering you...?>

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: It has a bit to do with something I remembered about my friend from club...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: But it's more of a personal matter...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <If talking to someone else about it will make you feel better, I'll be more than happy to listen.>

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: KAITO... Hehe. Thank you very much.

rows.Speaker: Host
rows.Line: You're so slender, and you have such long arms and legs. I'm so jealous...! You're like a life-size doll!

rows.Speaker: Host
rows.Line: Oh wow! You even glow when you laugh! It's like you're beauty incarnate!

rows.Speaker: Senior Member
rows.Line:
Isn't she though?
Her aura's so bright that we might need to start carrying parasols around with us!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (Okay, so far, I've managed to keep to the script...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (This live program will be over in just a little bit, but I need to stay focused until the end.)

rows.Speaker: MC
rows.Line: Alright, let's finish by asking our new lead here about her aspirations for the future.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
(No...
I practiced reading this part so many times! Why am I drawing a blank now...?)

rows.Speaker: Senior Member
rows.Line:
Try to relax, Shizuku...
You're tensing up so much that it's showing on your face.

rows.Speaker: Senior Member
rows.Line: But I guess it means you're just that excited. I'm sure Cheerful * Days has a bright future ahead of it as long as you maintain that sort of energy.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: As the lead, I'd like to do everything in my power to take Cheerful * Days to greater heights.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: So, we'll be looking forward to your continued support.

rows.Speaker: MC
rows.Line: Yes, I think we're all looking forward to seeing where Cheerful * Days goes! And thank you for joining us today!

rows.Speaker: Manager
rows.Line:
Nice work, everyone!
That went really well.

rows.Speaker: Manager
rows.Line: Although, Shizuku, that last part was concerning. Your fans want to see the perfect you, so please try to keep that in mind for next time.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (All I had to do was say what was written in the script. Why am I having so much trouble with that...?)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (I need to do a better job of being the “perfect Shizuku Hinomori”...)

rows.Speaker: Airi on TV
rows.Line: <Hey, what's this giant hole doing here?! Whose idea was it to make me fall into it right after I appeared?!>

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
(She's so incredible.
Recently, I've been seeing her on TV at least once a week...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I don't have time to feel sad. I need to try harder, like Airi...!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Oh, hello...!
Thank you for what you did just now!

rows.Speaker: Senior Member
rows.Line:
Haha. Anytime.
Things are more fun when we help each other out.

rows.Speaker: Senior Member
rows.Line: Also, I kinda want you to do well since I'll be stepping away from the group soon, you know...?

rows.Speaker: Senior Member
rows.Line: Hehe. We know that you're a hard-working girl, Shizuku, but try not to work too hard. It's important to relax sometimes.

rows.Speaker: Senior Member
rows.Line: That reminds me. You're entering high school soon, right? Miya Girls, was it?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes. The manager suggested that I go there since I mentioned that I wanted to put some effort into my studies.

rows.Speaker: Senior Member
rows.Line:
That's great!
And everyone keeps saying how nice Miya Girls is!

rows.Speaker: Senior Member
rows.Line: Being an idol and a student at the same time isn't easy, but I'm sure everything you learn will be to your benefit. So, good luck.

rows.Speaker: Senior Member
rows.Line: Also, have you thought about joining a club...? I mean, you only get one chance to enjoy your youth!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
A club...?
Actually, would you mind if I asked which club you were in?

rows.Speaker: Senior Member
rows.Line:
I was in the archery club!
Three years of that did wonders for my posture.

rows.Speaker: Senior Member
rows.Line: Yup. But there are plenty of other fun clubs to choose from, so you should choose the one that suits you best, Shizuku.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
I see...
I think I'll try a few different ones first.
The day of the entrance ceremony

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
Thank goodness I was able to find the gate.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Now, where is my class...?
They said that it should be posted on the bulletin board...

rows.Speaker: New Students
rows.Line:
She goes here?!
Whoa! She's so pretty...!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (Right. Many of my fans are going to be here. I can't let my guard down...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Airi!
I'd heard that we'd be going to school together, but I didn't expect to see you so soon...!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Not just that! We're in the same class! Talk about a happy coincidence!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: To be fair, the credit-based course doesn't have that many people in it, so I guess the odds of being put together were higher than normal.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Anyway, Shizuku, I'm looking forward to having a great year together!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
*Gasp*
We're really in the same class! I couldn't be happier...!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Oh, you. I get that you're happy, but you're acting like a Golden Retriever with its tail wagging around...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Oh, there's the bell...!
Let's go!

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line: You'll all be going home for the day now...

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line: But starting tomorrow, you will all have an opportunity to see what our clubs have to offer. Please feel free to visit any that you find interesting.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (Oh, we get to start visiting clubs tomorrow...?)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (Hehe. I'll be looking forward to that.)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Shizuku! I know you've been pretty busy lately, but are you thinking about joining a club?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, things have been busy, but I am hoping to join a club and participate as much as I can. What about you, Airi?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah, my choices are limited because of work, so I'm thinking about joining the tea ceremony club.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Have you already picked one out, Shizuku?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I still don't know if I'm going to actually join, but I'd like to visit the archery club...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Being an idol obviously takes priority, but who can blame us for wanting to enjoy high school life? Let's both make the most of our time here!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. I agree. Let's have as much fun as we can as idols and students!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: So this is what it's like to have all this archery gear on...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I wasn't expecting to get a chance to wear it since I'm just here to visit. Hehe. This is so wonderful...

rows.Speaker: Archery Club Captain
rows.Line: Prospective club members, do you all have your gear on?

rows.Speaker: Archery Club Captain
rows.Line:
First, allow me to introduce myself!
My name is Hayashi, the captain of the archery club! I hope you all enjoy your visit!

rows.Speaker: Archery Club Captain
rows.Line: Next, we'd like to hear from each of you. Oh, it'd also be nice to hear why you decided to visit.

rows.Speaker: First Years
rows.Line:
Whoa...!
She's gorgeous! Who is she?!

rows.Speaker: Second Years
rows.Line: Wait, isn't that...? She's in Cheerful * Days!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: My name is Shizuku Hinomori. I'm in Class 1-D.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I decided to visit the archery club because...a friend of mine used to do archery and said it's a nice way to improve one's posture...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (How much should I reveal...? Should I mention in advance that I'm an idol and may not be able to participate much...and risk making it awkward? Or later after I've actually joined...?)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I-I'd like to make the most of today's visit.

rows.Speaker: First Years
rows.Line: She seems kinda different compared to when she's on TV...

rows.Speaker: First Years
rows.Line: Yeah. I was under the impression that she was more mature and articulate.
I was impressed. I wish you the best of luck.
Yes, because your posture is already very good. The fact that you wish to further improve it left an impression on me.
Hehe. There's no need to thank me. I was just saying what I felt.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (Did she notice that I'm feeling a little down? Was she trying to cheer me up...?)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (That's so kind of her. And we only just met...)

rows.Speaker: Archery Club Captain
rows.Line: Alright, how about... You, next to her!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
(Oh, now it's her turn...
I wonder why she chose to visit the archery club.)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: My name is Mafuyu Asahina. I'm in Class 1-A and attended the junior high school here.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I decided to visit the archery club because...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: The captain handed me a flyer after the entrance ceremony.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I thought this club would be fun after seeing the way she was smiling as she handed flyers out...

rows.Speaker: Archery Club Captain
rows.Line:
R-Really?!
I feel kind of embarrassed now...

rows.Speaker: Second Years
rows.Line:
Haha!
But that's what makes you so great, Captain!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I'm a novice in terms of archery, so I hope you'll understand. And I'm looking forward to learning from all of you today.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (Not only is she kind, she's also mature and has this uncanny ability to create an uplifting atmosphere...)

rows.Speaker: Archery Club Captain
rows.Line: We'll begin with some strength drills! Archery is a sport that requires you to have a solid core!

rows.Speaker: Archery Club Captain
rows.Line: Let's start with five sets of thirty-second planks! Everyone, ready?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (I need to be perfect in order to avoid any more harm to my image...!)

rows.Speaker: Second Years
rows.Line: Oh, Hinomori, you seem to be doing just fine. Are these sorts of exercises a normal part of an idol's routine?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, our dance lessons usually involve these sorts of exercises.

rows.Speaker: Second Years
rows.Line:
That's so interesting!
Oh, Asahina's not doing too bad either...

rows.Speaker: Second Years
rows.Line:
Asahina's really kicking butt!
Were you in a sports club during junior high?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: No, I wasn't actually in a club, but I did help out from time to time.

rows.Speaker: Archery Club Captain
rows.Line:
Really?!
That makes what you're doing now even more incredible.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (I agree... She can handle this just fine despite not training on a regular basis...)

rows.Speaker: Archery Club Captain
rows.Line: Next, we'll use these training bows with rubber bands to practice drawing the string. Remember the eight steps that we just showed and try to put them into practice.

rows.Speaker: First Years
rows.Line: I-It's heavier than I thought... I can't draw it...

rows.Speaker: First Years
rows.Line:
I'm trying too...
But it's so hard just to stay in this position.

rows.Speaker: Second Years
rows.Line:
Oh, Hinomori, you're doing great!
Not many people can draw like that on their first attempt!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (But it's so difficult to keep it drawn...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
(The others make it look so easy too...
I had no idea how physically demanding this was...!)

rows.Speaker: Second Years
rows.Line:
Oh no! The band...!
Are you okay? Did you get hurt?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Y-Yes, I'm okay...
I'm so sorry. My hand slipped...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
(I was so close...
But I failed...)

rows.Speaker: Archery Club Captain
rows.Line:
Way to go, Asahina!
And you had a perfect follow-through!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: It was so much trouble in the beginning just drawing it back...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: But I managed to figure it out after seeing you do it yourself. So, thank you very much.

rows.Speaker: First Years
rows.Line:
That was so cool, Asahina!
Can you show me how you did that?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Um... Based on what I was told, you need to use your whole body to...

rows.Speaker: First Years
rows.Line:
Oh, okay!
I think I get it now!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
(That's astounding...
She's already figured out how to do it...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: She must be the true definition of perfect...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (If only I could do what she can...)

rows.Speaker: Archery Club Captain
rows.Line: Asahina, if you don't plan on joining any of the other clubs, would you like to join ours? I have a feeling that archery suits you very well!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Oh... Thank you for the offer...
Umm...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I did have quite a lot of fun today and wish to learn more... So, I think I'll accept.

rows.Speaker: Archery Club Captain
rows.Line:
You will?!
Thank you so much!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (I thought it'd be fun to give this a try and learn how to shoot...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (But it ended up being more difficult than I realized. I'm still getting on my feet as an idol, so I may end up becoming a burden if I'm not careful...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (Things may have turned out differently if only I were perfect like Asahina...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Are you not going to join, Hinomori?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I'm still a novice when it comes to archery, but I think it also suits you very well...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
I appreciate the compliment...
But why do you think that?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Not only is your posture beautiful, but the stern expression you made as you drew your bow really showed your determination.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: So, I thought it'd be fun if we could do this together.

rows.Speaker: Archery Club Captain
rows.Line: Asahina! Here's the form for joining! Write your name and class in these spaces.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I'd like to join as well.

rows.Speaker: Second Years
rows.Line:
Wow! Again, no misses!
You're a total pro now, Asahina!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
I have you and the others to thank.
Hehe. I never realized how good it'd feel when your arrow goes where you want it to.

rows.Speaker: Second Years
rows.Line:
I know, right?!
I think all of us remember the first time we hit the target.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
(Asahina's so incredible...
That means I also need to...!)

rows.Speaker: Archery Club Captain
rows.Line:
Oh, you dropped your arrow.
Don't worry. That happened to me a lot when I was first starting out.

rows.Speaker: Archery Club Captain
rows.Line:
Try relaxing a bit.
It tends to happen when you grip your draw hand a little too tightly.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: My draw hand... That's my right hand... Relax a bit and...

rows.Speaker: First Years
rows.Line:
Me too!
It's my first ever!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
(Oh...
The other first years are starting to show signs of improvement...)

rows.Speaker: Archery Club Captain
rows.Line: Hehe. It's normal to feel a little anxious with the newcomer tournament coming up and all, but it's okay. These things happen when you're just starting to learn.

rows.Speaker: Archery Club Captain
rows.Line: I know you're also busy as an idol, Hinomori, so let's just take it one step at a time!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yup! So, a lot happened and I put in my papers yesterday...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
B-But why...?!
As far as I could tell, things have been going very well for you recently.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Yeah...
It was nice to hear that our viewers liked seeing me...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: But it's not the kind of success I was looking for... As a result, I got into a big argument with my manager and the agency CEO...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: What do you mean? Not the kind of success you were looking for...?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Oh, don't worry about that. I should be fine from here on out...!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I put a lot of thought into it and decided that I need to change agencies in order to succeed in the way I actually want. So, again, I'll be fine.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I still have some questions, but you have my support, Airi. I agree that you should do as your heart says...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: However, it is sad to see you leave our agency...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hehe. That makes us rivals now. Watch out cause I'm not pulling any punches!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Right...
Let's both do our best.

rows.Speaker: Leader
rows.Line: You're the only one who still hasn't put on their outfit, right? Is everything okay? You seem preoccupied.

rows.Speaker: Leader
rows.Line:
Well, if you say so...
The show's about to start, so I need to get going...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (I made the decision to do my best as an idol, at school and at club.)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (But I've been having so much trouble that I've needed to rely on others just to get by...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (And worst of all... I couldn't see what Airi was going through...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: For the sake of our fans, I need to be perfect. I have to do my absolute best...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (I've learned to actually shoot arrows, but I'm yet to hit the target...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (At this rate, I won't be able to do anything meaningful during the newcomer tournament...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (The other girls from my year are showing clear signs of improvement, while I...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (It's only natural for a skill gap to develop since I can't attend every day...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (But I'm also having trouble as an idol.)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (Nothing has been going well despite how hard I've been trying... I couldn't even help Airi...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (I know it was recommended to me, but continuing with archery isn't a good idea...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (In this state, I'm only going to become a burden to the other club members.)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Hello.
Were you practicing by yourself?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Y-Yes.
Are you here to do the same...?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Yes, since we have that tournament coming up. I've been coming to practice in the morning for about a month now.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Still, Hinomori, I'm impressed by how you've been balancing being both an idol and a member of this club.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: No, you give me too much credit...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I've yet to hit the target even once, so I'd like to learn how to at least hit it before the tournament...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Hehe. That's exactly why I'm so impressed by you.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: You're doing your very best to overcome the obstacle that's in front of you.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (But Asahina's been practicing when no one else is around...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: You're such an incredible person, Asahina...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: You're such a good archer and a wonderful person... I am trying my best like you said, but I'm struggling to produce results.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Because of that...
I've been causing everyone around me so much trouble.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Why...? Why can't I be more perfect like you, Asahina...?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Far from it. That's why I'm here.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Taking up archery made me realize something. This place... It calms me.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I believe this is a place where you have no choice but to clear your mind of all other thoughts.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: If your mind wanders at all... If you're not fully focused on your arrow... It won't hit the target.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: So, I set everything aside when I'm here... School, my friends, all of it...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Focusing only on shooting has this way of calming me...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I have a feeling that you'll be able to move forward if you learn to do that...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (I've been so focused on “being perfect” that I let it get to me.)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
(I need to simplify things...
I need to temporarily set all of my worries aside...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (Then, I might just be able to move forward...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Would you like to join me, Hinomori? We can try attaining that calmness together.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Yes, of course.
Let's try together.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Okay, I'll give it a try...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
(First, establish your stance.
Correct your posture...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (Nock your arrow. Grasp the string. Maintain your posture. Raise your bow and arms...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Take a deep breath.
And focus on just that.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: This shot is all you care about right now.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (Right. I can't let anything else into my head...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
(You don't need to be perfect.
Just focus. Calm yourself...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (This shot is all that matters right now. Focus only on that...!)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
I-It hit...!
Asahina, my arrow hit...!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: If you learn to repeat that, I'm sure you'll do just fine during the newcomer tournament.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Thank you very much, Asahina.
I'm... I'm overcome with joy...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I was so worried that nothing would go right for me... I really didn't know what to do...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Hehe. You're a hardworking person, Hinomori, so I suspected that you were overthinking things a little.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Whenever that happens, it can feel like the walls are closing in on you, and you hate everything...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: However, I think you'll be fine now that you've learned to calm your mind.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I have a feeling that you'll be able to push much further ahead now.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Again, Asahina, thank you very much!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
(Don't worry...
Just calm yourself and focus...)

rows.Speaker: Second Years
rows.Line: Yeah, nice one! You've improved so much!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (I'm so glad that I practiced so much. I finally feel like a member of this club now...)

rows.Speaker: Archery Club Captain
rows.Line: She's so focused, and her accuracy is remarkable... She might be in the running to win it all.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: What? She has a chance to win...?!

rows.Speaker: Second Years
rows.Line: Man, Asahina, you were so close!

rows.Speaker: Archery Club Captain
rows.Line:
Fourth place is more than respectable!
It's hard to believe that you were just a novice not too long ago.

rows.Speaker: First Years
rows.Line: Does this mean Asahina's in line to become the next captain?

rows.Speaker: Archery Club Captain
rows.Line: Whoa, slow down. I'm standing right here...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (Despite this being her very first tournament, she produced incredible results...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (She says that she isn't perfect, but...)

rows.Speaker: First Years
rows.Line: Wait a second. I haven't seen Asahina at all since the award ceremony ended...

rows.Speaker: Second Years
rows.Line: She said she needed to use the restroom, but it's been quite some time now. We need to start heading out soon...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Oh, then...
I'll try finding her.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (I was hoping to find her here since she didn't seem to be in the restroom...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
(But I'm not seeing anyone.
I suppose it's because the award ceremony just ended.)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Oh, Hinomori, what are you doing here?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I, um... We need to head out soon, so I came to let you know.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Oh, it's already time...? I'm sorry. I felt somewhat tired, so I decided to take a quick break.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Yes, I understand.
The final round must've been very tense since it got so close...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Yes, it was.
My heart raced the entire time since I was competing against experienced archers.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
But I feel much better now.
Let's return to where the others are, shall we?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (She must've been more tired than I realized...)

rows.Speaker: Archery Club Captain
rows.Line:
Alright, let's wrap up practice here today!
It's chilly out, so try to stay warm, everyone!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Oh, Hinomori, do you have work after this?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Yes, I do.
I apologize for not being able to help clean up...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
That's okay.
You always do more than enough when you are available, so I wouldn't worry too much.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Oh, the weather forecast said that it might snow today, so please be careful, Hinomori.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Yes, I will.
Thank you, Asahina.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: It took longer than expected to change. I need to hurry...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
My manager's calling?
Hello, this is Hinomori.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh, the interviewer came down with a cold...? That's terrible...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: So, today's interview is going to be postponed? Understood. Thank you for letting me know.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
That means I don't have work today...
Hm...?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh, it's snowing... It's so beautiful.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
(Oh, that's right.
I asked Asahina to clean up in my place. If I go back now, I might still be able to lend her a hand.)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (I wouldn't want her to catch a cold since the archery range is exposed to the open air.)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
(Did everyone already go home...?
But the door was unlocked...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
(That's incredible...
But at the same time...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (And she seems to be mumbling something to herself...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (I can't quite make out what she's saying...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (It's as if she's an entirely different person...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Whenever that happens, it can feel like the walls are closing in on you, and you hate everything...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: However, I think you'll be fine now that you've learned to calm your mind.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I have a feeling that you'll be able to push much further ahead now.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
(But she's already very good at that...
And yet, it's almost as if...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (Something so significant that not even her calming technique will help...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
It's me, Asahina...
My appointment for today got canceled, so I was wondering if I could help clean up...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Oh, I see...
Thank you for coming back.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Unfortunately, I've already finished cleaning everything up, which is why I was practicing on my own.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Did something happen at work...?
Are you not feeling well by chance...?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
N-No, I feel fine!
It's just...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (She's back to being her usual self...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (Did I imagine what I saw just now...?)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Asahina did take a few days off here and there after that, but she seemed like her usual self...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: So I began to believe I had imagined what I saw that day...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Then, I became so busy with work that I didn't have much time to think about it...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
However, what I saw today...
That expression was so similar to the one she had back then. It really seemed like something was bothering her...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Hmm... What could be bothering her so much...?>

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: If something really is bothering her right now...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <If you do wish to help her, it might be good to actually say that.>

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: B-But... What if saying that makes her feel uncomfortable...?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <It should be no different from what you've been doing until now.>

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: What I've been doing until now...?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <Yes. You've been telling others that you're there for them.>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <There's no way for idols to know exactly what their fans are feeling or going through, but you can tell them that they have your support...>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <That sort of kindness can do wonders for a person in need.>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Hehe. You always seem to know exactly what to say, KAITO!>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
<Hm? I do?
I was just stating what came to mind...>

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I'll do my best to tell Asahina that I want to help and that I'm there for her.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: Welcome home, Mafuyu. It must be very cold outside, no?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: It's supposed to snow tomorrow according to the forecast, so be sure to dress warm.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: Also, it must be very cold during club activities...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Yes, it is since the archery range is an open-air area...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: I'm worried that you're going to catch a cold and miss cram school because of it...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: Your entrance exams are not too far off in the distance, so it may be time to reconsider whether club is worth your time.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I won't be able to immediately since I still have a lot to teach the younger members, but I'll start thinking about it...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line:
Oh, also...
I just brewed some tea.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: It should be steeped just right, so please have some, Mafuyu.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (But I don't feel warm after drinking it. Why is that?)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Okay, okay, I get it.
Also, don't run. It's dangerous...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. That's so cute. They're both just like Shibao.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yeah, like dogs playing in the snow. Well, we probably shouldn't tell them that...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Good morning, Hoshino, Mochizuki.
You all seem to be enjoying yourselves.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yes, we're all very excited about how it's snowing...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Hehe. I know how you feel.
Not only is snow beautiful, it's also fun to watch it fall from the sky.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: But be careful not to slip and fall, okay? It's supposed to snow quite a lot today.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Be right there!
Sorry, Asahina, if you'll excuse us.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I should head up to class...

rows.Speaker: Classmate A
rows.Line:
Ugh, I'm exhausted!
They've been giving us way too much homework lately!

rows.Speaker: Classmate B
rows.Line:
I know, right?!
Well, Mafuyu here knows how to make short work of that...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
I wish.
My cram school's also been giving me a lot of assignments, so I'm thinking about working on all that in the studying room today.

rows.Speaker: Classmate A
rows.Line:
Oh, you are?
Shouldn't you head home today since it's snowing? What if the trains get delayed or stopped?

rows.Speaker: Classmate B
rows.Line:
Yeah.
And the roads are gonna be all frozen and slippery by the time it's dark...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother's Message
rows.Line: <Since it's snowing and you don't have cram school today, how about I give you a ride home?>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: But I'd prefer to use the studying room. I feel like I can focus better there...

rows.Speaker: Classmate A
rows.Line:
Are you sure?
I mean, if you say so. Just be careful, okay?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <That's okay. There's something I need to ask my teacher, so I'll be using the studying room for a while.>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (Then, everything would be buried in snow. And I'd be able to stay here...forever...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Can I help you?
We don't have club activities today. Also, I thought you were practicing with Momoi and the others...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: They had some schedule conflicts, and it's snowing, so we decided to call it off.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: And... Asahina, if it's alright with you...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Would you like to practice shooting with me?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Yes, now.
What do you think?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Please...
I really need to practice with you today.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (It's rare for Hinomori to assert herself like this...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
(...
Plus, those assignments shouldn't take that long to complete...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Okay...
Just for a little bit.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Then, let's head over right now.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Sure.
Let me just grab my archery gear.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Fifty-eight, fifty-nine, sixty.
Okay, that's enough planking...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Now that we've warmed up, shall we practice shooting using the hay bales?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Remember how the two of us used to line up like this when we were first years?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Yes, I do.
And you were kind enough to help me when you saw that I was having trouble drawing the bowstring.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: You were very busy back then, so it must've been hard to learn how to shoot properly.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, it was. I had so much going on at the time...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: But I really need to thank you. I was able to stay in the archery club because of all the support you gave me.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Hehe. That's very kind of you, but I really didn't do anything all that special.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Remember how you practiced with me before the newcomer tournament when we were first years?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: The newcomer tournament when we were first years...?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Oh...
That's right. We did practice together here just before it.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Yes.
That time, you taught me how to calm myself...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: And how focusing on just shooting your arrow allows you to clear your mind of unnecessary thoughts...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: After putting what you said into practice, Asahina, I was able to hit the target for the first time...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Yes.
Back then, I had so much going on and didn't know what to do.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I was disappointing everybody at work and couldn't help Airi when she was thinking about changing agencies...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I kept beating myself up about not being able to do anything right.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: But then, you taught me that calming technique, and I was able to move forward from all that...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I learned how to focus on each arrow... I figured out how to put everything into my shot.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Still, all I did was say what I felt...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: What saved you that time may have been your work ethic. I was simply there to give you a gentle push.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, I'm standing here today partially because I worked very hard and didn't give up...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: However, I still believe that you played an important role in helping me when I needed it most...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: So, Asahina, thank you for what you did.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Just as you helped me that time, Asahina, I'd like to return the favor somehow.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: When we spoke the other day, you seemed very preoccupied with something...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: That reminded me of how you were just after the newcomer tournament concluded.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: You were practicing all by yourself while it was snowing... Which was somewhat concerning...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: So, I came to believe that something must be bothering you.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Something that not even your calming technique could help you overcome...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I'm sorry for bringing this up so suddenly, but that's how I feel...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: So, if there is something bothering you, I'd like for you to talk to me about it.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
You saved me once before, Asahina.
Now it's my turn to help you.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: When we spoke the other day... I was just beginning to feel the stress of exams since it's nearly that time of year...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: And when we were first years... I felt a bit frustrated over finishing in fourth place at the newcomer tournament, so I must've been somewhat on edge.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Yes...
So there's nothing for you to worry about.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
I see...
In that case, I apologize for jumping to conclusions. I didn't mean to be overbearing...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
No, that's okay.
I really appreciate how you're trying to look out for me.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
I know...
Since we have the hay bales out, why don't we have ourselves a little contest?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: We've never had many opportunities to shoot together like this. So, what do you think?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Good.
Oh, before we do, I'd like to use the restroom...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Okay, we'll go with the rules we just discussed. We'll each have four arrows and alternate each time we shoot.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
In the event of a tie...
We're supposed to keep going, but we can call it a draw to avoid staying too late.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Yes, I agree.
Let's both do our best.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (Ultimately, I wasn't able to learn what was bothering Asahina... I'm still in the dark...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (Which likely means that I won't be able to help her...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (Someday, as long as I'm able to lend her a hand when she does need me...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (So, for now... I need to become stronger.)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (I have to learn how to become a pillar of support for someone when they need me most.)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (And archery may actually help me achieve that goal...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (As usual, she had no trouble hitting her mark...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (It never ceases to amaze me. She's able to stay so focused but still relaxed as she fires each arrow...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (I always have so much trouble drawing since my right elbow and wrist have a habit of tightening up when I do.)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (And the more I try, the worse it gets. Just like when things weren't going well for me...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (Things feel different. I think I can nearly match her...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (This contest may actually end with a draw.)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I'm so sorry. I made sure to place it in my bag, but I forgot to put it on silent...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I know we're still having our contest, but I'll need to step out for a second.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Did something come up?
Should we...?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Uh, no... It's okay.
Just three more shots and we'll be finished.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
(What happened just now...?
She suddenly seems so...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
(What's going on...?
She's usually able to keep herself steady even when her focus lapses for a split second...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
(Calm your mind...
Otherwise, you won't be able to hit the target...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
(Breathe...
Focus only on pulling the bowstring back...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
(Thank goodness...
I hit it, but just barely...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (It's so strange how archery has this way of revealing your true mental state...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
(Her shoulders and elbows...
They seem completely frozen.)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
(What changed just now...?
Is it because of that message...?)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
(Maybe we should stop for now...
But...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
(No, I made my decision earlier...
I'm going to help her when she truly needs it.)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I don't know what's going through your head right now.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: But I'm sure you'll be able to calm yourself like you usually do...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: So, for now, just focus on this one shot.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
You're amazing, Asahina...!
That was such an incredible shot...!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
But this contest still isn't over.
Please give it your best shot.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Hehe. Hinomori, I think you're being too hard on yourself.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: But I missed my last shot...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Then, let's have another contest sometime.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: This one ended in a draw...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Yes, let's...!
And I promise to do my best then!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: At the same time... This place has a very different feel to it when it's snowing.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
I agree.
And no one else is here... It's almost like we're in a dream of some sort.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Speaking of which, I often used to make snow rabbits when I was little.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes. Because Shii always really liked it whenever I did.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh, this might be just enough snow... All you have to do is round some up into a ball and...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: For the eyes...we can use these bamboo berries, and some leaves for the ears. And there you are. A snow rabbit.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: At the same time, it's also a little sad that it's going to melt when the sun comes out...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Yes...
Shii used to say the same thing.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: The memory of having made this snow rabbit will remain.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
It may be physically gone...
But as long as you don't forget, it'll persist as a precious piece of your past.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: As long as I don't forget...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I can't say for sure, but want to believe it's true...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: So, I'd like it if you could remember what we did today...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I'm sure that there are already plenty of people around you who are willing to give you their support.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: But I'd like it if you could remember that I'm also there for you.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
(Huh...?
Just now. She seemed a little...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Anyway, it's starting to get dark, so let's head home.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
H-Hinomori?!
Is everything okay? Are you hurt?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
I-I'm sorry. I slipped on the ice...
That was so scary...!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Fortunately, I didn't get hurt so... Oh no!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
My umbrella... I bent it...
What do I do...?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Oh, you're right.
It probably won't open now...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: So, why don't we walk to the station together? We should both be able to fit under my umbrella.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Really?
Thank you so much, Asahina...!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Huh?
Is something the matter, Asahina?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: It's just... Hinomori, there's some snow on your face. Hehehe...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Just give me one second. I'll get it with my handkerchief...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Oh...
My hands are so cold. I guess I was outside for a fairly long time.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Mom said we're having curry for dinner tonight, so she was wondering if you could help peel the... Hm?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Did something good happen to you today...?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Oh, you noticed...?!
But I didn't say anything! You're like a mind reader, Shii!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I'm pretty sure anyone would've noticed. I mean, your grin sort of gave it all away...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Oh, so...!
Um... It's a bit of a long story, but...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I was able to give back a little today...

rows.Speaker: Mother's Voice
rows.Line:
Shiho! Shizuku!
Mind helping me with these?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh... Yes! We'll be right there!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Let's go, Shii! We can talk more in the kitchen!
